newsitem.title: USA: Cognex Corp acquires Mayan Automation.
newsitem.headline: Cognex Corp acquires Mayan Automation.

text.p: Cognex Corp said Friday it purchased the assets of Mayan Automation Inc, a privately-held company in Canada, for about $5 million in cash.

Of the $5 million, about $1.8 million will be paid in the future based upon the attainment of certain performance milestones. Cognex said it expects to expense about $3 million of the purchase price to pre-tax earnings in the third quarter for acquired in-process technology.
Mayan makes low-cost machine vision systems used to inspect materials made in continuous sheets, such as paper, plastics, metals, and non-woven materials.
Cognex, which makes machine vision systems, said it expects to develop a significant presence in the lower-cost end of the continuous process manufacturing market with the acquisition.
